_comment: Seed findings for the lab's codemender-scan.yml mode=mock. Lab data only. commit_sha is filled in by the workflow at scan time.

findings.title: SQL injection in search_items
findings.description: search_items() interpolates the source query parameter into the SQL text with an f-string. Input such as ' OR '1'='1 returns every catalog item, and a UNION can read the sources table. Reachable from GET /api/items?source=. Fix: use a parameterized query.

findings.title: Path traversal in read_note
findings.description: read_note() joins data/notes/ with the file query parameter without normalizing the result. ../ sequences read files outside the notes directory. Reachable from GET /api/notes?file=. Fix: resolve the path and require it to stay inside the notes directory.

findings.title: MySQL root password passed to Cloud Run as a plaintext env value
findings.description: terraform/main.tf sets DB_PASSWORD and MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD as plaintext env values on the Cloud Run service, and the app connects to MySQL as root (CWE-250). Anyone who can view the Cloud Run revision or the Terraform state sees the credential; CM-0001 then runs with full database privileges. Fix: store the password in Secret Manager and reference it with value_source.secret_key_ref, and connect as a least-privilege database user.

findings.title: End-of-life base image python:3.8-slim-buster
findings.description: The image is built FROM python:3.8-slim-buster. Python 3.8 and Debian 10 (buster) are end of life and get no security fixes. Fix: move to a supported base such as python:3.12-slim-bookworm and rebuild.
